speech_verification.heard: A wealthy Texas school chose free-waste gas to save money. Most people assume professionals inspected the gas system. Officials actually tapped a local residue line. Untreated gas carried no warning scent, hiding a leak beneath the floors. An electric sander then sparked the trapped fuel. Nearly 300 lives were lost, creating today's mercaptan laws. That tragedy happened because a wealthy Texas school chose free-waste gas.

notes.hook: Clear and intriguing, though the text 'SAVING MONEY, LOSING LIVES' is a bit blunt.
notes.clarity: The narrative sequence is easy to follow and concise.
notes.payoff: Connecting the tragedy to the ubiquitous 'rotten egg' smell of modern gas is a strong payoff.
notes.visuals: Archive photos are highly relevant and clear.
notes.loop: The transition from the final line back to the first is seamless.
notes.accuracy: All claims are supported by the provided research and disputed points guidelines.
